_moonlit_sands_notes: Moonlit Sands: hand-shipped VS Code theme. Omarchy's built-in template generates this file from colors.toml; a copy shipped in the theme folder replaces that output (for the author and for anyone who installs the theme). This field lists every key that differs from the template's output and the extra keys added after it. VS Code ignores this field.

To regenerate after a palette change: delete this file from the theme folder, run `omarchy theme refresh`, copy ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/vscode-theme.json back into the theme folder, re-apply the changes below, then render the kit's `full-key-templates/vscode-extra-keys.json.tpl` with this theme's colors.toml and merge its colors keys in.

Colour roles: night page = background #141d2d (editor, gutter, minimap, text inputs, breadcrumb strip, widgets inside the editor); chrome = dark_background #0e1622 (activity bar, side bars, panel, status and title bars, tab strips, inactive tabs, section headers, menus, dropdowns, quick input, notifications, welcome and settings surfaces, every button and control at rest); darker_background #0b111e = every border and divider, the pressed state, shadows, and boxes set apart (terminal, output view and their sticky scroll, code blocks, overlays); hover = lighter_background #41332f; selected, active and focused = selection #4e403c with bright_foreground #eeba8a text; focus rings and every active border = accent #eb9d52; checked toggles and active options = accent fill with background text.

Colour roles, continued: text = foreground #e0a269; secondary, inactive, placeholder, description, line numbers, side bar text, disabled = muted #8b7d71; faintest readable ink and hints = dark_foreground #9a6e45; cursor and text on a chosen row = bright_foreground; text on accent or solid notice fills = background; links, badges and progress = accent; scrollbar = lighter_background at rest, accent under the pointer, bright_foreground while dragging (minimap slider the same three at 12% / 25% / 38%); error and deleted and conflicting = red, warning and modified = yellow, info = blue, success and added and untracked = green, ignored = muted, notice fills = the 30% blends, diff tints = the slot at the template's alpha, bracket guides and charts = terminal colours; current line = dark_background; text selection, find matches, word and symbol highlights = selection (overlays at the template's alpha); indent guides = darker_background, active guide = muted.
